findings.text: God-file: 2807 LoC / ~45 top-level functions mixing hand-rolled routing, SQL clause builders, item JSON shaping, search, stats, path serving and ETags in one file; partial decomposition elsewhere (writes.go, book_wire.go, series_features.go, batch_chapters.go) proves split responsibility was feasible.

Hand-rolled route matching: ~180 lines of parts[N]==... prefix/method case chains inside Handle(...), violating the documented architecture rule (register on http.ServeMux, no Handle-chain). Pre-dates the rule, so MED not HIGH.

Stub wired live: libraryItems() returns 501 'collapsed series are not implemented' whenever ?collapseseries=1 (route itself active, upstream clients relying on series collapsing get an explicit failure); same pattern for unsupported media types (2081) and error-mapped 501 from filterClause (2086).
Duplication: the 21-column libraryItems SELECT list is copy-pasted verbatim in two places; shared scanItemRow mitigates scan drift but the column list has no single owner.

Repeated silent_except '_ = json.Unmarshal(user.Permissions, &permissions)' — malformed permissions JSON silently yields an empty permission set (fail-closed, safe, but scattered ~4+ times with no shared helper).
'_ = walkErr' discards zip-walk errors mid-stream; explicitly documented bounded compat (headers already sent; upstream logs and ends the same way).
Dead no-op branch: 'if id == "listen-again" { id, label, key = "listen-again", "Listen Again", "LabelListenAgain" }' assigns identical values; only the mirrored branch changes anything.
